title: Aggregate Two Time Series
summary: Given two 2D integer arrays, each containing [timestamp, value] pairs sorted in increasing timestamp order, create an aggregated series by summing corresponding values at each timestamp.
statement: Given two 2D integer arrays, each containing [timestamp, value] pairs sorted in increasing timestamp order, create an aggregated series by summing corresponding values at each timestamp. For timestamps not present in a series, use the next available value or 0. Return the aggregated series as a sorted [timestamp, summedValue] array.
constraints: At a timestamp missing from one series, use that series’s next available value, or zero if none remains.
Return every timestamp from either series with the two applicable values summed.
reference_solution:
def aggregate_future_time_series(series1,series2):
    i=j=0;answer=[]
    while i<len(series1) and j<len(series2):
        t1,v1=series1[i];t2,v2=series2[j]
        if t1==t2:answer.append([t1,v1+v2]);i+=1;j+=1
        elif t1<t2:answer.append([t1,v1+v2]);i+=1
        else:answer.append([t2,v1+v2]);j+=1
    answer.extend(series1[i:]);answer.extend(series2[j:]);return answer

At the smaller timestamp, pair its value with the other pointer’s next value.
Advance whichever timestamp was emitted; advance both on equality.
Once one series ends, the other values pair with zero and can be appended.
